on: a paragraph over a page break ends its earlier page with a full line (pull request 517, fix/page-cut-line): the line that holds the page cut ends where the breaker ends it, and page B opens at the next line

why: page A's last line is full and page B opens at a line's start, as TeX sets a paragraph over a page break; a half-empty line before the break read as the paragraph's end and split words across the pages (1706.03762v7 p4 and p8).
